items.title: Progressively build LAB-local canonical memory before task planning
items.description: All relevant observations, tests, sources, decisions and checkpoints shall be recorded chronologically in GitHub LAB, analyzed before turning into executable tasks

items.title: No parallel dispatcher or direct GACR queue writes
items.description: LAB findings only generate candidate investigations until existing canonical task/dispatcher authority explicitly releases work

items.title: Avoid making premature technical remediation decisions
items.description: D03 F1 provenance and D04 acceptance compatibility require further source review; no implementation or merge approved by memory registration
